rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: The bulletin combines the Crime Survey for England and Wales with police recorded crime.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: CSEW headline crime was estimated at 9.6 million incidents with no statistically significant annual change.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: CSEW estimated 2.6 million theft incidents with no statistically significant annual change.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Other household theft increased by 21% to about 791,000 incidents.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded about 5.2 million crimes excluding fraud and computer misuse, 1% fewer than the previous year.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: CSEW estimated around 646,000 criminal-damage incidents with no statistically significant annual change.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded 433,251 criminal-damage offences, a 2% annual fall.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: CSEW estimated 4.5 million fraud incidents with no statistically significant annual change.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Estimated fraud prevalence was 7.8%, an increase of 0.7 percentage points.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Bank and credit account fraud increased by 15% to about 2.8 million incidents.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Other fraud decreased by 37% to around 151,000 incidents.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded crime is collected from 43 territorial forces plus British Transport Police.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded figures are a snapshot taken on 8 June 2026 and cover data through March 2026.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded crime covers a broader set of offences and populations than CSEW.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded crime excludes offences that are not reported to or recorded by police.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded trends can be affected by recording practices, policing activity and public reporting.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: CSEW estimates for years ending March 2021 and March 2022 are unavailable because face-to-face interviewing was suspended.

rows.source: ONS Crime in England and Wales
rows.verified: Police recorded crime supports local statistics but does not provide exact parcel-level incident probability.
